description: FHIR R4 Condition resource — a clinical condition, problem, diagnosis, or other event, situation, issue, or clinical concept that has risen to a level of concern.

fields.label: Resource ID
fields.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource.

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: Business identifiers assigned to this condition by the performer or other systems.

fields.label: Clinical Status
fields.description: The clinical status of the condition. Values: active | recurrence | relapse | inactive | remission | resolved.

fields.label: Verification Status
fields.description: The verification status to support the clinical status of the condition. Values: unconfirmed | provisional | differential | confirmed | refuted | entered-in-error.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: A category assigned to the condition. e.g. problem-list-item | encounter-diagnosis.

fields.label: Severity
fields.description: A subjective assessment of the severity of the condition as evaluated by the clinician.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: Identification of the condition, problem or diagnosis. Coded using ICD-10, SNOMED CT, or similar.

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Indicates the patient or group who the condition record is associated with.

fields.label: Encounter
fields.description: The Encounter during which this Condition was created or to which the creation of this record is tightly associated.

fields.label: Onset Date Time
fields.description: Estimated or actual date or date-time the condition began, in the opinion of the clinician.

fields.label: Abatement Date Time
fields.description: The date or estimated date that the condition resolved or went into remission.

fields.label: Recorded Date
fields.description: The recordedDate represents when this particular Condition record was created in the system.

fields.label: Recorder
fields.description: Individual who recorded the record and takes responsibility for its content.

fields.label: Note
fields.description: Additional information about the Condition. This is a general notes/comments entry for description of the Condition, its diagnosis and prognosis.
